reviewCorrections: MET21 and MET31 query through data-owner ports within one RepeatableRead snapshot; no consumer SQL into another owner.
MET32 duplicate conflicts are unavailable; incompatible signatures never produce pooled distributions.

Full SQL first run: 71 passed / 1 failed due to MET21 fixture sharing the real-source player and period. Isolated synthetic dates fixed the fixture, preserving assertions and reader filters; entire suite rerun.
limitations: One real observed match/patch; multiversion and longitudinal examples explicitly synthetic.
Observed imported cohorts, bounded queries and correlated players; nominal intervals do not establish causality or individual trends.
No production performance/capacity claim, deploy or production data mutation.
